Game Design and Development Program
The Honours BA in Game Design and Development degree
program
is only available at the Brantford Campus.
The Bachelor of Arts in Game Design & Development
will introduce students to all of the skills necessary to conceptualize,
create, adapt, and promote a game and use games to create
transformations in the social and cultural spaces they inhabit.
Graduates will be well positioned to communicate across the spectrum of
gaming professions and understand the unique contributions brought by
programmers, designers, story boarders, editors, etc.
